name: designprint
description: Print for AI agents. Makes business cards from a name and contact details, and prints flyers, posters, menus, invitations and signs designed in the conversation, at an exact size. Returns a proof, the price and one link where the person pays as a guest. Ships within the United States.

interface.longDescription: Designprint is a print shop your agent can use. Ask for business cards and it makes a two-sided card from your name and contact details. Or have the agent design a flyer, poster, menu, invitation or sign and print it at an exact size. You get a proof, the price and one link to approve it and pay as a guest. Nothing is printed until you pay. Delivery is within the United States.
defaultPrompt: Make business cards for me and send me the link to order them
Design a flyer for my event and get it printed
Print this poster at 18 x 24 inches and ship it to me
